Method of Attack: Exploitation of Exchange Server vulnerabilities to deploy malicious cryptominers and maintain unauthorized access via web shells.
Attack Vector: Remote code execution vulnerabilities in Exchange Server (CVE-2021-28480 through CVE-2021-28483)
Indicators of Compromise: Web shells planted on victim computers
Cryptominer payloads hosted on compromised Exchange Servers

Attack Vector: Elevation of privilege via Azure ms-rest-nodeauth library
